title: Two Neighbours
text:
Maria and Peter are neighbours. They live in houses next to each other, near the park. Maria has a small dog, and Peter likes to play with it every morning.

One day Maria was sick and could not walk her dog. Peter took the dog for a walk and brought it back with a smile. Maria was very grateful and invited Peter to dinner.

questions.text: Why could Maria not walk her dog one day?
How does Maria probably feel about Peter after that day?
options: She does not want to see him

questions.text: What kind of relationship do Maria and Peter probably have?
options: A friendly, caring relationship between neighbours

vocabulary.definition: feeling thankful for something someone did
the main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening

paragraph_translations: Марія і Петро — сусіди. Вони живуть у сусідніх будинках біля парку. У Марії є маленький собака, і Петро щоранку любить із ним гратися.
Одного дня Марія захворіла і не могла вигуляти собаку. Петро повів собаку на прогулянку і привів її назад з усмішкою. Марія дуже була вдячна і запросила Петра на вечерю.
